## Failures and recovery, if needed

Keep failed results intact. Record the exact difference and observed partial state; do not relabel a failed first operation as accepted. If importer/layout/identity/topology changes or partial writes require recovery, record its bounded authority, preservation comparison and repeat result here. Add exhaustive affected-closure evidence to this same report rather than opening a duplicate review trail.
